method: Read-only searches, explicit-URL page opens, and focused finds. Read statuses distinguish full relevant excerpts, location-only evidence, an opened index, and indexed context when full opens failed. No direct quotations are reproduced.
scope: Narrow setting, function and chronology facts for 24 additions; no verification of all drawn geometry, film frame timing or source loops.

checks.fact: Isengard has underground industrial workshops before the Ents destroy and flood them.
checks.adaptation: The source verifies the industrial setting and chronology. The wheel transmission and empty bellows are functional adaptations; no exact film prop or cycle is certified.

checks.adaptation: An empty shaft and lift repeat a decorative stroke. No blast, transport, arrival event or playable floor is changed.

checks.adaptation: The small pivot/cable rig is an authored mechanical study with an empty safe return cycle. Trigger tiles, lightning, damage and falling gameplay blocks are excluded.

checks.adaptation: An empty bell/clapper/chain linkage moves without audio, glass breaking, path unlocking or realm changes. It is a released-game setting adaptation, not unused sounding-pipe finale footage.

checks.adaptation: The mechanism is restricted to the preceding working-generator scene. Belt, fan and engine geometry are functional setting adaptations, not a verified physical generator prop.

checks.adaptation: The 1982 film plot was also read and confirms MacReady’s flight and subsequent vehicle sabotage. Parked airframe and turning main/tail rotors are approximate geometry; the 2002 game and 2011 prequel are excluded.

checks.fact: The 1981 recorder uses unequal 5-inch and 7-inch reels; the same recorder has equal 7-inch reels in Evil Dead II.
checks.adaptation: The draw keeps the 1981 unequal radii and corresponding 7:5 rotational ratio. Tape travel is silent and its repeated timing is original; no incantation or possession is played.

checks.fact: The Evil Dead II workshed sequence includes a bench vice.
checks.adaptation: Only the empty screw, body and jaws move; no occupant, body part, blood, sound or injury is reenacted. The article establishes the prop, not its dimensions or an idle loop.

checks.fact: The Cairo box unfolds into a key and later fits the Hamunaptra sarcophagus lock.
checks.adaptation: Eight petals are supported by indexed box references, but their exact silhouette is not validated. The unfolded key, inferred internal bolts and cycle are authored; the coffin lid stays closed and nobody appears.

checks.fact: Pinako operates the Resembool artificial-limb shop; Winry is Edward’s automail mechanic.
checks.adaptation: The empty test hand, fixture and linked finger joints interpret workshop function. These are not a claimed frame or actual healing/transmutation of a character.
